chrome_hint: eBay AU sold+completed: 'vintage Kenner Star Wars Chewbacca loose' ; 'Kenner Star Wars Ben Kenobi loose' ; 'Kenner Star Wars Princess Leia loose'; 'vintage star wars figure lot Kenner 1977 loose' (Terapeak, last 90 days, Australia plus ebay.com sold for Kenobi/Leia). Also Pickers/Collectors Weekly, Sworders/Hake's sold lots for loose first-12 lots. Check whether figures are Hong Kong or Taiwan/Hong Kong marked and if Kenobi has grey hair (later) versus white hair.
viewing_check: Check the copyright stamp on leg or back (Kenner 1977 / G.M.F.G.I., Hong Kong or other), Kenobi hair colour and whether arms are intact, Chewbacca bowcaster and fur condition, Leia cape and yellowing, joint tightness, any paint wear, any reproduction signs.
